name: Baker Timber Products
old_description: Baker Timber Products is transitioning out of our retail sales division. We will no longer be taking orders or selling products to the public. We will be continuing our wholesale and in-woods operations. A huge thank you to all of our customers over the years, we truly appreciate your business
about:
Baker Timber Products operates from Rapid City, South Dakota. The company has transitioned away from retail sales to focus on wholesale and in-woods operations, a shift announced on its website.

The firm supplies timber, wood, and mulch products through wholesale channels and conducts in-woods operations, which typically involve harvesting and primary processing of logs. Specific manufacturing processes, facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not publicly disclosed.

The company serves wholesale customers in the timber and landscaping sectors, though specific industries and customer examples are not detailed in available sources.

The company has not publicly stated a founding mission or specific differentiators beyond its strategic shift to wholesale and in-woods operations.
